Selection Tests Report

Date: 2026-05-22

Objective: Perform explicit statistical tests (Fisher's exact, Hudson FST, PBS, and Local Window FST outlier scans) to identify patterns compatible with positive and negative/purifying selection for previously flagged candidates.

1. Input Data & SNP Compilation

  • Previous Files Used: /output/adaptive_sweep/PID_comparison/... and /output/adaptive_sweep/...

  • Genotypes Used: /raw/Tibetan.fstat.1240K.260508.bed/.bim/.fam

  • Selected SNPs: Inherited directly from previous reports, preserving exact snp_label, rsID, mapped_gene, and trait mappings. 274 candidates were extracted.

2. Group Selection & Inference

  • Previous Targets: Dynamically inferred from the adaptive sweep markdown (Zongri4.7k, etc.).

  • Early/Basal Eurasian: Ust_Ishim, BachoKiro_IUP, BachoKiro_UP, ZlatyKun_IUP.SG (Pooled to capture Deep Paleolithic drift).

  • Eastern Basal Eurasian: Tianyuan, AR33K, Onge.DG, McColl_SEA_GR1.

  • Selected European Reference: Sunghir (N=5). Chosen because it represents an unadmixed Upper Paleolithic HG group with sufficient baseline observations compared to other n=1 Paleolithic Europeans.

  • Other Comparisons: 18 independent eastern Eurasian PIDs.

3. Methods & Statistics

  • Positive Selection: Hudson FST and Fisher's exact tests applied to test for extreme enrichment in Target vs References. PBS (Population Branch Statistic) computed where European and Early_Basal were valid outgroups.

  • Negative Selection: Fisher tests checking for significant depletion of known putatively deleterious alleles.

  • Local Window FST: Core SNP FST computed against the background FST distribution spanning a ±500kb window. SNPs > 95th percentile flagged as outlier.

  • Haplotype-based Tests: Marked as not_computed_due_to_unphased_or_sparse_ancient_data. iHS and XP-EHH require dense phased diploid data, which our pseudo-haploid 1240K targeted capture cannot provide.

  • Temporal Modeling: Simple logistic regression framework mocked, but dates from SampleInfo metadata generated too sparse valid continuous timelines for robust tracking.

6. Limitations & Caveats

  1. Missingness & Ascertainment: The ancient samples are capture-based pseudo-haploids. Tests applied on sparse observations are incredibly sensitive to bottleneck drift and stochastic sampling.

  2. False Positives in Unphased Data: Differentiating selection from extreme founder drift is difficult without phased haplotype decay metrics (like iHS/XP-EHH), which are impossible to compute here.

  3. Selection Inference: Allele frequency divergence alone constitutes a compatibility with selection. No SNP is definitively 'confirmed' purely from these tests without corroborative functional assays.
